last.verdict: Beat on profit and volumes, but a big run-up left only a small gain.

reasons.label: Profit beat
reasons.text: Organic operating profit rose 5.8%, above the 4.6% analysts expected.

reasons.label: World Cup volume lift
reasons.text: Volumes grew 0.9%, a second straight rise; management still expects a 25 basis point World Cup boost despite Brazil and Mexico exiting early.

reasons.label: Weak US and China
reasons.text: US sales to retailers and wholesalers fell, and China volumes dropped 9.7%.

story: Volumes fell 1.5% in late 2025, then turned positive in the first quarter of 2026 (+0.8%) and again in Q2 (+0.9%). Profit growth has run around 5-6% a year, with the full-year outlook kept. The stock has gained about 36% this year, so good news is already largely priced in.
